versions.subject: Rule: Outlook spawning shells to detect Turla like C&C via Outlook
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 1
    ParentImage:
        - '*\OUTLOOK.EXE'
    Image:
        - '*\cmd.exe'
        - '*\powershell.exe'
        - '*\wscript.exe'
        - '*\cscript.exe'
        - '*\sh.exe'
        - '*\bash.exe'
        - '*\schtasks.exe'
condition: selection
